title: Formalize concrete target-write row certificates in Lean
head: 96ef13e9c0aada8730ace8624fde2de1e3ddb1b9
body:
This formalizes the concrete execution-to-row-generation step of the target-write lemma in #1546. For an arbitrary finite register set and chronological legal XOR word whose raw execution is the identity, the theorem constructs exact Boolean masks expressing every row of `I XOR projected` using the last `m - 1` actual target-write donor occurrences. It permits dirty inputs, repeated donors and target feedback; zero target writes are handled separately.

The full source passes Lean 4.30.0 (`d024af099ca4bf2c86f649261ebf59565dc8c622`, core/Std only). A separate reporting-only compile checks all 78 theorem declarations, including 13 private helpers, with axiom union `propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound` and no placeholder/custom axiom. Lean fixtures cover donor chronology, feedback, repeated donors and wrong sampling; 1,170 small external mask-elimination checks also pass. The portable replay wrapper rejects missing or malformed axiom reports and wrong source/toolchain pins.

The generic Python package hook passes, but it does **not** compile Lean. The dedicated `replay.py` provides that check with an already installed exact compiler. No numeric rank API, three-cycle application, helper reduction, BFS, 13-gate optimum, supplier or multiplication theorem is formalized here.

Scoped under [Discussion1548](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1548), on a fresh branch from main `adc34159e0d6dc3dd2af2bdba3f5ca7376ef957e`. Revision 3 keeps independent verification as a current priority; the original revision-2 assignment remains recorded as historical provenance. The selected frontier is unchanged.

Prepared by Andrey Mas with substantial GPT-6 Pro formalization and fixture-checker assistance through ChatGPT, and Codex source coordination, execution audit, replay and mechanical packaging. The written lemma remains credited to #1546; precursor raw/projected and write-count work is due to Gareth Davidson / @bitplane (#1420), following @woklerx (#1105). No predecessor Lean implementation is copied. Apache-2.0.

Validation: registered `research_package.py` hook for `research/target-write-row-certificate`, plus exact Lean `replay.py`; commands, hashes, complete axiom receipt and limitations are in the package.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
